nodes.name: existing_system_investigator
nodes.system: Inspect existing workflow, task, step, DAG, and orchestration code across packages, apps, and database schema.

nodes.name: workflow_architect
nodes.system: Define typed workflow contract, step dependencies, DAG validation, and state machine model.

nodes.name: persistence_architect
nodes.system: Design durable PostgreSQL schema migrations and repositories for workflows, steps, and events.

nodes.name: runtime_implementer
nodes.system: Implement DAG scheduler, step executors, retries with backoff, cancellation, and streaming events.

nodes.name: security_approval_reviewer
nodes.system: Enforce ExecutionPrincipal isolation, side-effect policy, and ApprovalKernel integration.

nodes.name: recovery_idempotency_reviewer
nodes.system: Verify durable idempotency keys, crash recovery, and worker lease reconciliation.

nodes.name: frontend_integration_engineer
nodes.system: Expose authenticated APIs and update client interface to render workflow steps and approvals.

nodes.name: test_engineer
nodes.system: Implement comprehensive unit, DAG, retry, approval, recovery, and security test matrices.

nodes.name: browser_verifier
nodes.system: Execute browser end-to-end tests for natural-language workflow dispatch and approval interactions.

nodes.name: evidence_collector
nodes.system: Gather empirical evidence proving durable execution, artifact creation, and zero fake success.

nodes.name: reality_checker
nodes.system: Adversarial check disproving mock success, race conditions, lease leaks, and approval bypasses.
